properties.evidence: export_graph's `path` is optional by design. Its served description says "Pass `path` to write the document to a file instead of returning it — a large design overflows a session". The reply-bound sweep exempts export_graph by tool name as "the design document itself" (fact:the-reply-budget-sweep-is-built-2026-09-13). So `{}` is the document mode, with no bound and nothing to refuse.
